target_customer: Nonprofits receiving donor-advised fund gifts, and DAF sponsors and grantmakers sending grants
problem: DAF gifts are slow, paper-based and hard to reconcile for nonprofits. Chariot builds payment rails and gift processing for them.
business_model: Payment processing fees and software for nonprofits and DAF sponsors
product_category: Fintech, nonprofit payments and DAF infrastructure

founders.name: Aaron Kahane
education: University of Pennsylvania, summa cum laude

founders.name: Drew Schneider
education: Dartmouth College, human-centered design, summa cum laude

competitors.name: Daffy
competitors.what: Donor-advised fund platform founded by Adam Nash that sends donations directly from an account
competitors.traction_then: Founded 2020; later features such as campaign pages came in 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with DAF sponsors, nonprofit donation forms and payment rails plus banking partner compliance; standard fintech engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Embedding on 100,000 plus donation forms and connecting DAF sponsors creates a two-sided network that is hard to replicate once both sides integrate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DAF sponsors did not build a comparable payment network quickly; Chariot raised a Series A in 2024 and was named to TIME Best Inventions 2025.

market_need_then: DAF assets were about 326B USD and the fastest growing segment of philanthropy, but nonprofits had no easy online way to accept DAF gifts.

branding.domain_note: Uses givechariot.com (prefix 'give'); the exact chariot.com was apparently unavailable but no source states it

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission-led, giving oriented; founders drew on the Jewish tithing principle of ma'aser per JTA 2022

branding.brand_signature: DAFpay, the product name, is the recognizable asset and was named TIME Best Invention 2025
branding.community_and_virality: Press from TIME, Fast Company, Axios and Chronicle of Philanthropy; DAF Day launch with nonprofit partners.

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly real word that is shared by unrelated companies, so confusable, but the DAFpay product name and strong press helped awareness.

outcome_analysis: Chariot, founded in 2022 and in YC Summer 2022, solved a concrete DAF payment gap for nonprofits and sponsors, raised an 11M USD Series A led by Maveron in August 2024, and by 2025 reported DAFpay embedded across tens of thousands of nonprofits including GoFundMe and Givebutter. It launched gift processing in January 2026. No acquisition or later round found.
notes: Series A stated by the company and Axios (August 2024); Seedtable lists YC as lead, which conflicts. Seed amount not stated. Nonprofit counts conflict (100,000 on YC page, 60,000 on careers page, tens of thousands on site). The Daffy listing relies on a search summary of its about page; Fidelity Charitable and other sponsors are not listed as competitors because no dated source was opened.
